# Release v1.1.0

This release updates the project for a cleaner GitHub presentation and release-ready setup.

## Highlights

- refreshed project documentation and version metadata
- added a real screenshot asset for the calculator UI
- improved the README for a more polished project landing page
- kept the app functionality stable with the existing FastAPI API and calculator frontend

## Included features

- modern calculator interface
- arithmetic evaluation API at `/api/calc`
- static frontend served by FastAPI
- local startup script and CI support

## Notes

This is a lightweight full-stack demo designed for learning and sharing as a first vibe coding project.
